funds.faqIntro: The questions institutional desks ask first: security, providers, execution and data.

onboarding.q: How long does it take a fund to onboard?
onboarding.a: There is no environment to build. A desk connects its data and brokerage, brings strategies through the Laboratory or the API, and runs its first studies in the first week. Most of the calendar is the strategies themselves, not the setup.

data.q: Whose data does Fintela use, and can we bring our own?
data.a: Asset groups are built from Fintela's market data across equities, ETFs, forex and global markets. External strategies and fitness functions can read your own data sources through the API, so proprietary signals stay on your side.

sharing.q: Can we keep some strategies private inside the team?
sharing.a: Yes. Everything is private by default. You share a strategy, an asset group or a study with named colleagues or with the whole organisation, and you can publish results-only dashboards that hide code and parameters.

committee.q: What can we hand to an investment committee?
committee.a: PDF reports built from any trial or basket: equity curves across train, validation and out-of-sample windows, drawdowns, parameter importance and the trade log, with code and hyperparameters withheld.

cost.q: What does it cost to start?
cost.a: The free tier includes the Laboratory, asset groups and studies with the basic samplers and allocation methods. Advanced features unlock per basket with tokens, so you pay for what a study actually uses.

ownership.a: You do. Strategies are private by default, hashed and time-stamped as yours, and you can export any trial's daily signal as JSON or CSV at any time.
